description: This file defines API routes for CRUD operations related to 'notes' in a note-keeping application using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It includes functions for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, all associated with an authenticated user.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note( payload: NoteCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new note for the authenticated user using provided title and content.

methods.name: list[NoteOut] list_notes( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists all notes belonging to the authenticated user, ordered by creation time descending.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note( note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note( note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of an existing note belonging to the current user.

methods.name: None delete_note( note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a specific note owned by the current user.
